text.text: Manage every partner from first call to renewal. Milestones show what is owed, and transactions add up the revenue each partner brings.
Referred revenue and commission come from the transactions you log. Log them monthly and the totals below stay honest.
Revenue share and commission rate recorded
Tracking link tested end to end
What the partner needs from us

cells.text: They sell and support our product
They promote with a tracked link

text.text: Choosing the right kind of partner
Referral: they introduce, you sell. Pay a fee only when the deal closes.
Reseller: they sell and support your product. Agree a margin and who owns support.
Integration: your products connect. The reward is shared customers, not money.
Co-marketing: joint webinars, guides or events. Agree who owns the leads before you start.
Affiliate: anyone with an audience and a link. Keep the terms short.
Write one sentence for each partner: what each side gives and what each side gets. If it does not fit in one sentence, it is not ready.
